trailhead.label: Ville di Giovo, the APT’s start

cautions: The viewpoint and the ridge are at a cliff edge: keep your dog on a short lead.
A steep, narrow descent through a cleft in the rock ridge, with rough ground.
About 1 km on quiet tarred lanes through the vineyards.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
